Task Name: Document Current Application Architecture
Description: Inventory the tasky Go web application stack including runtime (Go/Gin), database (MongoDB 4.0.x), storage (S3 backups), containerization (Docker multi-stage), and Kubernetes orchestration (EKS). Capture all service endpoints, ports, environment variables, and configuration dependencies.
Acceptance Criteria: Application architecture documented with all component dependencies, ports, environment variables, and service interactions captured in a technical specification

Task Name: Inventory Current AWS Infrastructure as Code
Description: Catalog all Terraform modules (vpc, eks, mongodb-ec2, s3-backup, alb) and their resource definitions. Document provider versions, backend state configuration (S3 + DynamoDB), variable inputs, outputs, and inter-module dependencies.
Acceptance Criteria: Complete inventory of all Terraform modules, resources, variables, outputs, and state backend configuration documented

Task Name: Inventory GitHub Actions CI/CD Workflows
Description: Document current GitHub Actions workflows: build-and-publish.yml (Docker image CI), terraform-plan.yml (IaC validation), terraform-apply.yml (IaC deployment + app deploy), cost-analysis.yml (cost reporting). Capture all secrets, variables, OIDC configuration, and environment references.
Acceptance Criteria: All CI/CD workflows documented with secrets, variables, triggers, environment references, and deployment flow captured

Task Name: Document Current Tagging and Billing Strategy
Description: Review current AWS resource tagging strategy (Project, Environment, StackVersion, ManagedBy, Owner, CreatedDate) and document billing/cost tracking approach for migration to Azure tagging and cost management.
Acceptance Criteria: Current tagging taxonomy documented with mapping to Azure tag requirements for billing codes and IS asset tracking

Task Name: Identify Application Configuration Dependencies
Description: Map all application runtime configuration: MONGODB_URI, SECRET_KEY, PORT, GIN_MODE, and any other env vars. Document Kubernetes manifests (deployment, service, ingress, configmap, secret, rbac, namespace) and their cloud-provider-specific dependencies.
Acceptance Criteria: All application configuration dependencies mapped with cloud-provider-specific items flagged for migration

Task Name: Map VPC Networking to Azure Virtual Network
Description: Map AWS VPC (10.0.0.0/16), public/private subnets across 3 AZs, Internet Gateway, NAT Gateway, route tables, and VPC endpoints to Azure Virtual Network, subnets, NSGs, NAT Gateway, and service endpoints.
AWS Source Service: AWS VPC + Subnets + IGW + NAT GW
Azure Target Service: Azure VNet + Subnets + NSG + NAT GW
Acceptance Criteria: Documented mapping of AWS VPC components to Azure VNet equivalents with CIDR planning and subnet strategy

Task Name: Map EKS to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
Description: Map AWS EKS cluster (v1.28), managed node groups (t3.medium, ON_DEMAND), EKS addons (vpc-cni, coredns, kube-proxy, ebs-csi), IRSA for ALB controller, and cluster security groups to AKS equivalents.
Acceptance Criteria: Documented mapping of EKS cluster configuration to AKS including node pools, addons, managed identity, and networking model

Task Name: Map MongoDB EC2 to Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB
Description: Map self-managed MongoDB 4.0.x on EC2 (Amazon Linux 2) to Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB API as PaaS replacement. Evaluate API compatibility, connection string format, authentication, and data migration strategy.
Acceptance Criteria: Documented mapping of MongoDB deployment to Cosmos DB for MongoDB API with compatibility assessment, connection string format changes, and authentication approach

Task Name: Map S3 Backup Storage to Azure Blob Storage
Description: Map S3 bucket (versioning, lifecycle, public read access) to Azure Blob Storage with container access policies, lifecycle management, and public URL access pattern for MongoDB backups.
Acceptance Criteria: Documented mapping of S3 backup bucket configuration to Azure Blob Storage with equivalent access policies, lifecycle rules, and public URL format

Task Name: Map ALB to Azure Application Gateway or AKS Ingress
Description: Map AWS ALB (via AWS Load Balancer Controller in K8s) to Azure Application Gateway Ingress Controller (AGIC) or nginx-ingress on AKS. Evaluate Kubernetes ingress compatibility and TLS termination.
Acceptance Criteria: Documented mapping of ALB/ingress approach to Azure equivalent with ingress controller selection and configuration plan

Task Name: Map IAM Roles and OIDC to Azure RBAC and Managed Identity
Description: Map AWS IAM roles (EKS cluster role, node group role, ALB controller IRSA, MongoDB EC2 instance profile with AdminAccess) to Azure RBAC, Managed Identities, and AKS workload identity.
Acceptance Criteria: Documented mapping of all IAM roles and OIDC federation to Azure RBAC assignments, managed identities, and AKS workload identity

Task Name: Map CloudWatch Logging to Azure Monitor
Description: Map AWS CloudWatch log groups (MongoDB backup logs) to Azure Monitor Log Analytics workspace and container insights for AKS monitoring and diagnostics.
Acceptance Criteria: Documented mapping of CloudWatch logging to Azure Monitor with Log Analytics workspace design and AKS container insights plan

Task Name: Map Terraform State Backend to Azure
Description: Map Terraform S3 backend with DynamoDB state locking to Azure Storage Account backend with blob state storage and state locking.
Acceptance Criteria: Documented mapping of Terraform backend from S3/DynamoDB to Azure Storage Account with state locking configuration

Task Name: Create Azure Terraform Provider Configuration
Description: Create Azure Terraform provider configuration with azurerm provider, required versions, and feature blocks. Configure backend for Azure Storage Account state management.
Acceptance Criteria: Azure Terraform provider configuration with azurerm provider, version constraints, and Azure Storage Account backend configured

Task Name: Create Azure Resource Group Module
Description: Create Terraform module for Azure Resource Group with standard tagging inputs for billing codes (billing_code, cost_center) and IS identifiers (information_system_id, system_owner, data_classification). Support dev and prod environment tiers.
Acceptance Criteria: Resource group module with parameterized environment tiers (dev/prod), standard billing tags, and IS identifier tags

Task Name: Create Azure Virtual Network Module
Description: Create Terraform module for Azure VNet with subnets (AKS subnet, services subnet, app gateway subnet), NSGs, NAT Gateway, and service endpoints. Support dev/prod sizing via variables.
Acceptance Criteria: VNet module with configurable subnets, NSGs, NAT Gateway, service endpoints, and environment-tier sizing for dev and prod

Task Name: Create Azure AKS Cluster Module
Description: Create Terraform module for AKS cluster with system and user node pools, managed identity, RBAC enabled, Azure CNI networking, container insights, and ingress controller integration. Support dev (1 node) and prod (2-3 nodes) tiers.
Acceptance Criteria: AKS module with configurable node pools, managed identity, RBAC, networking, monitoring, and dev/prod tier sizing

Task Name: Create Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB Module
Description: Create Terraform module for Cosmos DB account with MongoDB API (4.0 compatibility), database, and collection. Configure throughput (RU/s) for dev (400 RU/s) and prod (1000 RU/s) tiers. Include connection string output for app configuration.
Acceptance Criteria: Cosmos DB module with MongoDB 4.0 API, configurable throughput per environment tier, connection string output, and proper access controls

Task Name: Create Azure Blob Storage Module
Description: Create Terraform module for Azure Storage Account with blob container for MongoDB backups. Configure lifecycle management, access tier, and optional public read access equivalent to S3 bucket policy.
Acceptance Criteria: Storage module with blob container, lifecycle management, access controls, and public URL capability for backup files

Task Name: Create Azure Application Gateway / Ingress Module
Description: Create Terraform module for Application Gateway or configure AKS with nginx-ingress controller for external application access. Support HTTP/HTTPS and health check configuration.
Acceptance Criteria: Ingress/App Gateway module with HTTP/HTTPS support, health checks, and integration with AKS cluster

Task Name: Create Azure Monitor and Log Analytics Module
Description: Create Terraform module for Log Analytics workspace and diagnostic settings for AKS container insights, Cosmos DB metrics, and application logging.
Acceptance Criteria: Monitor module with Log Analytics workspace, AKS container insights, and diagnostic settings for key resources

Task Name: Create Root Module with Standard Tag Inputs
Description: Create root main.tf that composes all Azure modules with standard variable inputs for billing_code, cost_center, information_system_id, system_owner, data_classification, environment (dev/prod), and project_name. Wire all module outputs.
Acceptance Criteria: Root module composing all Azure modules with standardized tag inputs for billing and IS tracking, supporting dev and prod environments

Task Name: Create Environment-Specific tfvars Files
Description: Create terraform.tfvars templates for dev and prod environments with appropriate sizing, throughput, and configuration values. Include billing code and IS identifier placeholders.
Acceptance Criteria: Environment-specific tfvars files for dev and prod with documented variable placeholders for billing and IS identifiers

Task Name: Update Terraform Plan Workflow for Azure
Description: Update terraform-plan.yml to replace AWS OIDC credentials with Azure OIDC (azure/login action), update environment variables from AWS_REGION to AZURE_LOCATION, and configure Azure-specific Terraform init with Azure Storage backend.
Acceptance Criteria: Terraform plan workflow updated with Azure login action, Azure environment variables, and Azure Storage backend init

Task Name: Update Terraform Apply Workflow for Azure
Description: Update terraform-apply.yml to replace AWS credential configuration with Azure OIDC login, update EKS-specific kubectl config to AKS (az aks get-credentials), replace AWS-specific deployment steps with Azure equivalents.
Acceptance Criteria: Terraform apply workflow updated with Azure login, AKS kubectl configuration, and Azure-specific deployment steps

Task Name: Verify Build and Publish Workflow Compatibility
Description: Verify that build-and-publish.yml (Docker image to GHCR) requires no changes since it uses GitHub Container Registry independent of cloud provider. Document any required updates.
Acceptance Criteria: Build and publish workflow verified as cloud-agnostic or updated if any Azure-specific changes are needed

Task Name: Update Cost Analysis Workflow for Azure
Description: Update cost-analysis.yml to replace AWS cost estimation with Azure cost estimation using Azure Pricing Calculator references and Azure-specific resource cost components (AKS, Cosmos DB, Blob Storage, App Gateway).
Acceptance Criteria: Cost analysis workflow updated with Azure pricing references and resource cost components

Task Name: Configure Azure OIDC Federation for GitHub Actions
Description: Create documentation and configuration for Azure AD app registration with federated credentials for GitHub Actions OIDC authentication. Define required secrets (AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID).
Acceptance Criteria: Azure OIDC federation documented with app registration steps, federated credential configuration, and required GitHub secrets listed

Task Name: Update Kubernetes Manifests for AKS Compatibility
Description: Review and update K8s manifests (deployment, service, ingress, configmap, secret, rbac, namespace) for AKS compatibility. Replace AWS-specific annotations (ALB ingress class, AWS LB controller) with Azure equivalents.
Acceptance Criteria: Kubernetes manifests updated to remove AWS-specific annotations and add Azure/AKS-compatible ingress and service annotations

Task Name: Validate Terraform Plan for Dev Environment
Description: Run terraform init and terraform plan for the dev environment tier to validate all Azure modules compile, pass validation, and produce a correct execution plan without errors.
Acceptance Criteria: Terraform plan succeeds for dev environment with no errors and expected resource creation count

Task Name: Validate Terraform Plan for Prod Environment
Description: Run terraform init and terraform plan for the prod environment tier to validate all Azure modules with production-tier sizing and configuration.
Acceptance Criteria: Terraform plan succeeds for prod environment with production-tier resource sizing and configuration

Task Name: Validate GitHub Actions Workflow Syntax
Description: Run workflow linting and validation on all updated GitHub Actions workflows to ensure correct YAML syntax, valid action references, and proper secret/variable references.
Acceptance Criteria: All updated GitHub Actions workflows pass syntax validation and linting checks

Task Name: Create Migration Validation Checklist
Description: Create a comprehensive validation checklist covering infrastructure deployment, application connectivity, database access, storage access, monitoring, and CI/CD pipeline execution for both dev and prod environments.
Acceptance Criteria: Migration validation checklist created with all critical checkpoints for infrastructure, application, and CI/CD verification

Task Name: Document Rollback Strategy
Description: Document rollback procedures in case Azure deployment fails or application issues are detected. Include steps to revert to AWS infrastructure and data recovery procedures.
Acceptance Criteria: Rollback strategy documented with step-by-step procedures for reverting to AWS infrastructure
